items.title: Awesome Neovim
items.content_text:
### AI / Diagnostics

*   [you-n-g/simplegpt.nvim (⭐31)](https://github.com/you-n-g/simplegpt.nvim) - Provide a simple yet flexible way to construct and send questions to ChatGPT.

### Utility / Diagnostics

*   [josephburgess/nvumi (⭐51)](https://github.com/josephburgess/nvumi) - Natural language calculator in a scratch buffer.
*   [johannww/tts.nvim (⭐15)](https://github.com/johannww/tts.nvim) - Text to speech tool based on the Microsoft Edge online services.

### Git / Diagnostics

*   [wsdjeg/git.nvim (⭐7)](https://github.com/wsdjeg/git.nvim) - An asynchronous git command wrapper plugin, using `:Git` command instead of `:!git`.

items.content_text:
### Stream Processing

*   [Pathway (⭐49k)](https://github.com/pathwaycom/pathway): Performant open-source Python ETL framework with Rust runtime, supporting 300+ data sources.
